description: Figure 6 is a line chart titled "Token Resolution Breakdown for FedHLM: Local, P2P, and LLM Token Distribution." The chart displays the resolution percentage on the y-axis, ranging from 0 to 80, against the "Degree of Non-IIDness" on the x-axis, which is categorized as Low, Medium, and High. It presents data for three different resolution methods: Local Resolution (solid blue line), Edge P2P Resolution (dashed green line), and LLM Resolution (dotted red line). The Local Resolution line starts at approximately 85% for Low non-IIDness and decreases to about 75% at High non-IIDness. The Edge P2P Resolution line remains relatively flat, starting at around 10% and ending at approximately 12%. The LLM Resolution line shows a steady increase, starting at about 10% and rising to roughly 25% as non-IIDness increases. The legend is located in the top right corner of the chart.
